user.title: Add a Kitlig instance
user.description: In Kitlig, open Settings, MCP Server and turn on the server, Listen on network and Phone companion. A Docker or headless Kitlig has these on already.

data_description.host: The computer running Kitlig, by name or IP address.
data_description.port: Kitlig's server port. 8420 unless you changed it.
data_description.password: The Kitlig Web password, or the MCP token shown in Kitlig's settings. It is used once to sign in and is not stored.

discovery_confirm.title: Kitlig found: {name}
discovery_confirm.description: Sign in to the Kitlig at {host} to add it.

data_description.password: The Kitlig Web password, or the MCP token shown in Kitlig's settings. It is used once to sign in and is not stored.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to {name} again
reauth_confirm.description: Kitlig no longer accepts this Home Assistant's sign-in. It may have been removed from Kitlig's device list.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Kitlig at that address. Check that Kitlig is running and that Listen on network is on.
error.invalid_auth: Kitlig did not accept that password.
error.web_off: Kitlig answered, but Phone companion is off. Turn it on in Kitlig's Settings, MCP Server.
error.device_cap: This Kitlig already has its maximum of 10 signed-in devices. Remove one in Kitlig's Settings, MCP Server, Devices, then try again.
error.rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.wrong_instance: That address belongs to a different Kitlig instance.

abort.already_configured: This Kitlig instance is already added.

data_description.scan_interval: Changes arrive live; this check is the safety net.
data_description.browser_url: Only needed when your browser reaches this Kitlig at a different address than Home Assistant does, such as a public address behind a reverse proxy. Enter the full address, starting with http or https. Used for site and game links.

cancel_job.name: Cancel job
cancel_job.description: Stops a running or queued Kitlig job.

config_entry_id.name: Instance
config_entry_id.description: Which Kitlig. Can be left empty when only one is added.

job_id.name: Job ID
job_id.description: The job to stop, from the Jobs running sensor's attributes or a job event.

retry_job.name: Retry job
retry_job.description: Runs a failed or cancelled Kitlig job again with the same inputs.

config_entry_id.name: Instance
config_entry_id.description: Which Kitlig. Can be left empty when only one is added.

get_site_url.name: Get site or game link
get_site_url.description: Returns a link that opens a Kitlig site or game in a browser. The link works for 12 hours.

config_entry_id.name: Instance
config_entry_id.description: Which Kitlig. Can be left empty when only one is added.

site_id.name: Site ID
site_id.description: From the Sites or Games sensor's attributes.

page.name: Page
page.description: A page file such as about.html, or index.html?scene=level2.json for a game scene. Opens the start page when empty.

no_instance.message: That Kitlig instance is not connected.

instance_required.message: More than one Kitlig is added. Say which one.

no_failed_job.message: There is no failed job to run again.
